stem.text: What is the circuit symbol for an oscilloscope?

A.alt: Circuit symbol: a vertical bar and a circle joined to horizontal lines.

B.alt: Circuit symbol: a horizontal line with a wavy mark and two small circles on it.

C.alt: Circuit symbol: a circle containing a zigzag mark on a horizontal line.

D.alt: Circuit symbol: a semicircular dome above a stepped shape on a horizontal line.
